title: In Edit Line, a former technician with logged time shows the lock
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member B, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, so the list has a technician to compare with.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in In Progress, led by staff member B, with one approved line, line 1, so the line belongs to someone else's work order.
  • Have staff member A, a technician for this test (Parts Manager role, Time Clock on, Technician on, enrolled at the test location only), on line 1 of work order 1 with time logged on line 1 (they pressed Start on it and later stopped), and then switch staff member A's Technician off (and save the warning), so they are on the line but no longer a technician.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open Edit Line for line 1.
  3. Hover staff member A's chip.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • Staff member A's chip shows the existing lock and no X.

Step 3:

  • The text "This technician has logged time on the line and cannot be removed." shows, as today.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S3-R8: “Someone already on a line who is not offered per S3-R1 stays on the line. In the Edit Labor technician list they show grayed out, the same as a deactivated technician today; that list is in name order, so they appear among the others alphabetically, and they cannot be unticked there. In Edit Line they show as an ordinary chip that can be removed with its X, unless they have logged time on the line, in which case the chip shows the existing lock and "This technician has logged time on the line and cannot be removed.", as today. Saving a line's technicians in Edit Line keeps a person who is no longer a technician on the line unless the user removed them. As today, saving also drops a person from the line who has a labor entry on the work order but is not in the location's Time Clock list (deactivated, Time Clock off, on the built-in Office User or Time Clock User role, or not enrolled at the location) and has no time logged on that line; such a person who is on the line only through Add Technician, with no labor entry, stays.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "6 Technician dropdowns on a work order", picture "Add Technician on a line" (This build)

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p6-04-after-add-technician-on-a-line.png

The design's own words:

  • “Not offered: Parth Fadadu follows Nikola Milosevic. Add Labor uses the same list.”
  • “Anyone already on a line who is not a technician any more stays on it and shows grayed out, the same as a deactivated technician today.”

Difference: the caption on this picture says a former technician on a line "shows grayed out"; S3-R8 says an ordinary chip with its X in Edit Line (register TT-D02, PO question 6). This case follows the PRD and is held.
